result.summary: Wrote test/specs/REQ-058.md and test/letflow/engine/lua_script_audit_test.exs against Letflow.Engine.LuaScriptAudit.execute_script_for_audit/6, using inline test-double Executor modules (EchoExecutor, MismatchExecutor, RaiseIfCalledExecutor, RecordingExecutor).
